QuestInfo.name: [Legion Champion] Rank B Champion Trial
QuestInfo.0: You hear that you can raise up to a Rank B Champion if you prove your strength by defeating a powerful Maple World enemy... Go see Imperial Knight Sir Hamselot.
QuestInfo.1:
You hear that you can raise up to a Rank B Champion if you prove your strength by defeating a powerful Maple World enemy... Go see the knight Sir Hamselot.

#r* Completable by defeating Lotus (Hard) Champion Mode.
#r* Hamselot's Trial The Hamselot's Trial effect (30% reduced Final Damage) is applied in Champion Mode.
#r* Champion Mode can only be challenged solo.
#r* Defeating in Practice Mode will also count for Champion Mode, and challenging in Practice Mode will apply Hamselot's Protection.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Maple World's powerful enemy and proved you're qualified to be a Rank B Champion.

default.0: It doesn't look like you completed the champion trial yet. Come back after you're qualified.\n\n#r* You can complete it by defeating Lotus (Hard) Champion Mode.
